remarks: Ideally located just moments from the vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment of Downtown Stamford, this fully renovated 3-4 bedroom single-family home offers the perfect blend of modern comfort, style, and flexibility. Situated in the highly desirable Newfield neighborhood and only 45 minutes to NYC, this property is move-in ready and designed for today's lifestyle. Features include: Private primary ensuite bedroom located on the upper level. 2-3 additional bedrooms on the main level, offering flexible space for bedrooms, guest rooms, or a home office. Open-concept kitchen with modern finishes and great natural flow. Beautiful full bathroom on the main level, featuring luxurious heated floors. Fully finished lower level with a full bathroom, laundry area, and additional flex space-perfect for an office, family room, gym, or playroom. Fully fenced-in patio-ideal for family gatherings and outdoor entertaining. Unique no-maintenance turf yard, perfect for pets, and easy upkeep. Deck directly off the kitchen, providing seamless indoor-outdoor living. This home is move-in ready and perfectly suited for today's lifestyle-with space to live, work, and entertain in comfort. Don't miss your opportunity to live in one of Stamford's most convenient and desirable neighborhoods!
